nodes.description: Base.creator: privileged address assigned from msg.sender in constructor
BasicAuth.auth_list: mapping(address=>bool) of authorized operators
MainCard.g_CardLib: card definitions and card index list
MainChip.g_ChipLib: chip definitions, temp timers and part managers
MainBonus.g_Bonus: bonus pool, record day, per-player and per-day bonus data
MainBag.g_BagList: per-player stuff, chips and card inventories
MainBonus.receiver: address receiving leftover contract balance
Main.g_Synced: one-shot guard for legacy data migration
Child.g_Main: Main contract instance used for external calls
Home.g_SignInDay: last sign-in day per address
MainBonus.BASERATIO: ratio denominator constant 10000
BasicTime.DAY_SECONDS: seconds per day constant
Base constructor assigning creator = msg.sender
BasicAuth.SetAuth: grants auth_list rights, guarded by ValidHandleAuth
BasicAuth.ClearAuth: revokes auth_list rights
IndexList.insert: shifts array elements with an incorrect forward loop
IndexList.remove: compacts array and shrinks self.length
MainBonus.Withdraw: computes player bonus and transfers ether to acc
MainBonus.MasterWithdraw: transfers surplus balance to receiver
MainBonus.AddBonus: increases reward and record bonus pools
MainBonus.ImmediateProfit: moves bonus from pool to player balance
MainBonus.RefreshDayBonus: rolls bonus pool forward to today
MainBonus.QueryPlayerBonus: view computation of accrued player bonus
Child.GenRandom: derives pseudo-random value from msg.sender, seed and now
Child.AddBonus: forwards msg.value to Main and credits a percentage
Child.kill: revokes auth on Main and selfdestructs to creator
Child constructor: stores Main address and calls SetAuth
Main.GainCard: grants a card, chips and profit to a player
Main.InsertCard: creator-only card and chip registration
Main.GenChipByRandomWeight: weighted random chip generation for caller
Main.SyncOldData: one-shot migration from legacy contract for accounts
Home.GetDayReward: daily sign-in reward granting stuff and temp stuff
Home.Donate: payable entry forwarding value into the bonus pool
Home.Withdraw: proxies a withdrawal request to Main for msg.sender
MainChip.CostChip: returns a chip and decrements its used counter
MainChip.BeforeChipCost: restores chip availability when limit is freed
MainChip.GetChipUsedNum: counts active chip usages from temp timers
MainChip.ObtainChip: takes a chip and increments its used counter
BasicTime.GetDayCount: converts a timestamp into a day number
BasicTime.GetExpireTime: day-aligned expiry timestamp
msg.sender: caller identity used for auth and randomness
tx.origin: transaction origin used in authorization modifiers
block.timestamp (now): used for days, expiry and randomness
Authorization by tx.origin==creator / acc==tx.origin instead of msg.sender
acc.transfer(bonus) external value transfer inside Withdraw
receiver.transfer(bonus) external value transfer inside MasterWithdraw
address(g_Main).transfer(msg.value) external call in Child.AddBonus
IndexList.insert writes self[i+1] in an incrementing loop causing OOB/wrap
Unchecked increment/decrement of m_UsedNum chip counter
self.length-- and self.length++ storage array length arithmetic
Randomness derived from msg.sender, seed and block.timestamp
g_Bonus.m_RewardBonus -= bonus unchecked subtraction
address(this).balance - g_Bonus.m_RewardBonus unchecked subtraction
selfdestruct(creator) destroys the Child contract
msg.value * percent / 100 unchecked multiplication before division
target address of SetAuth/ClearAuth
acc address parameter of Withdraw and related functions
bonus amount parameter of MainBonus.AddBonus
random seed parameter supplied to GenChipByRandomWeight
seed parameter of Child.GenRandom
modulus base parameter of Child.GenRandom
accounts array parameter of SyncOldData
iChip/iCard index parameter of chip and card entry points
percent parameter of Child.AddBonus
self uint32[] storage parameter of IndexList functions
r: pseudo-random value computed in Child.GenRandom
expireTime: day-aligned expiry used in GainCard2/AddChipTempTime
bonus: accrued player bonus computed in Withdraw
todayNo/dayNo: current day derived from block.timestamp
i: loop index inside IndexList.insert shift loop

edges.reason: constructor assigns creator from msg.sender
ValidHandleAuth checks msg.sender before granting auth_list rights
SetAuth authorization accepts tx.origin==creator
SetAuth writes auth_list[target]=true
ClearAuth deletes auth_list[target]
ValidHandleAuth gate on SetAuth is tx.origin based
ValidHandleAuth gate on ClearAuth is tx.origin based
OwnerAble(acc) authorizes Withdraw with acc==tx.origin
Withdraw day accounting relies on block.timestamp
acc.transfer executes after bonus state update and can invoke a fallback
Withdraw subtracts bonus from m_RewardBonus without bounds check
Withdraw reads and writes g_Bonus player and pool data
receiver.transfer sends ether to an arbitrary receiver address
balance minus m_RewardBonus can underflow if pool exceeds balance
MasterWithdraw reads g_Bonus.m_RewardBonus
AddBonus increases m_RewardBonus and m_RecordBonus
Child.AddBonus performs an external transfer before calling g_Main.AddBonus
msg.value * percent / 100 multiplies before dividing
Child.AddBonus calls g_Main via the stored Main address
GenRandom mixes now into the random seed
block.timestamp is a miner-influenceable randomness source
day accounting is derived from block.timestamp
GetExpireTime internally calls GetDayCount
RefreshDayBonus branches on GetDayCount(now)
Home.GetDayReward sign-in gating uses block.timestamp
insert shifts with self[i+1] and writes past the enlarged array bound
remove mutates storage array length with self.length--
CostChip decrements obj.m_UsedNum without checking for underflow
GetChipUsedNum accumulates the mutable used-count inputs
kill executes selfdestruct(creator)
kill clears the Child auth entry on g_Main
SyncOldData flips g_Synced to prevent replay
SyncOldData writes migrated inventories into g_BagList
GetDayReward stores the current day in g_SignInDay
GetDayReward grants rewards through g_Main
Donate forwards value into Child.AddBonus
Home.Withdraw delegates the payout to Main.Withdraw
InsertCard registers the new card in g_CardLib
InsertCard registers each part chip in g_ChipLib
GenChipByRandomWeight obtains the generated chip
GenChipByRandomWeight reads part manager index lists
GainCard reads card configuration from g_CardLib
ImmediateProfit moves value inside g_Bonus
RefreshDayBonus rewrites g_Bonus record fields
QueryPlayerBonus reads g_Bonus and player bonus data
ObtainChip mutates chip usage state in g_ChipLib
BeforeChipCost restores chip entries in part manager lists
Child constructor stores the Main instance in g_Main
Base constructor initializes the creator authority

normalization_plan.reason: target is only meaningful as the address authorized by SetAuth/ClearAuth
acc selects the beneficiary resolved during Withdraw
bonus is the value added into the g_Bonus pools by AddBonus
random seeds the weighted chip selection
seed is consumed by the GenRandom hash input
base only bounds the value produced by GenRandom
accounts drives the migration iteration in SyncOldData
iCard/iChip identifies the chip obtained during generation
percent scales the forwarded value in Child.AddBonus
self is the storage array mutated by the shift loop in insert
r is the predictable random value derived from timestamp and sender
expireTime is produced by the day-aligned GetExpireTime helper
bonus is the computed payout used for the acc.transfer in Withdraw
todayNo/dayNo is the day number derived from block.timestamp
i is the loop counter that drives the out-of-bounds shift in insert
